Results: Grouped matches, counts, amounts, dates, and detail navigation.
Filters: Date, amount, account, member, category, project, status, and record type; Apply/Clear.
Details: Open existing record screens; preserve search state on return.
No Results: Helpful empty state with Clear Filters.

Acceptance: Capture actual iOS/Android screenshots, compare against references, verify all supported search/filter/navigation flows, and preserve existing bookkeeping functionality. Do not mark complete based on appearance alone.
